summary: Creates a MAT input connector on a Component so external material inputs can be wired into reusable component networks.

key_params.name: label
key_params.note: Popup label shown for this Component MAT input

key_params.name: dodeform
key_params.note: Enable deform handling on the incoming material

key_params.name: deformdata
key_params.note: Choose SOP, MAT, or Deform In MAT as bone-data source

key_params.name: targetsop
key_params.note: SOP with capture data for deform workflows

key_params.name: skelrootpath
key_params.note: Root component path for skeleton transforms

key_concepts: In MAT creates a material input connector on the left side of a Component so parent networks can feed MATs into reusable components.
Component MAT inputs are positioned alphanumerically, making stable node names part of the public component interface.
The Label parameter documents the connector for users hovering over the Component input.
In MAT also exposes deform and common render-state pages, so it can change material behavior if those wrapper states are edited.
When the incoming material participates in skinned rendering, deform data source, capture SOP, and skeleton root settings must align with the geometry.
common_gotchas: Component MAT inputs are ordered alphanumerically, so stable names matter for reusable components.
In MAT exposes common MAT state; it is not just a passive socket when render-state pages are changed.
Deform settings must match the geometry's capture attributes when the incoming material participates in skinned rendering.
Use labels to make component material inputs understandable in larger templates.
